results.title: Institutional license delivered cleanly
recommendedActions: Allow billing, renewal, expansion, and revenue-recognition workflows to proceed with the attached delivery evidence.

results.title: Active billing before customer access is delivered

findings.message: The entitlement delivery packet lacks a stable evidence hash.
findings.remediation: Attach a sha256 evidence hash for the provisioning export, acceptance record, or delivery audit packet.

findings.message: The customer has not accepted or acknowledged entitlement delivery.
findings.remediation: Capture customer or authorized account-owner acceptance before marking delivery complete.

findings.message: The internal account owner has not acknowledged the provisioned entitlements.
findings.remediation: Require account-owner acknowledgement before renewal, expansion, or recognition workflows proceed.

findings.message: One or more purchased entitlements are under-provisioned.
findings.remediation: Provision the purchased seats, quotas, storage, and compute before billing or revenue recognition proceeds.

findings.message: A purchased analytics or data feed is not enabled for the customer.
findings.remediation: Enable the purchased feed or hold revenue workflows until delivery is complete.

findings.message: The provisioned support tier is below the signed contract tier.
findings.remediation: Upgrade the support entitlement or hold billing and recognition until support delivery matches the contract.

findings.message: Revenue recognition remains ready while entitlement-delivery findings are unresolved.
findings.remediation: Set a revenue hold until delivery evidence, quota parity, support tier, and term checks pass.

recommendedActions: Place revenue recognition and renewal automation on hold.
Attach entitlement findings to the revenue operations review packet.
Reconcile contract lines against provisioned seats, quotas, feeds, and support tier.
Regenerate delivery evidence after provisioning or commercial amendments are complete.

results.title: Expansion account over-provisioned before true-up

findings.message: One or more entitlements exceed the signed contract and need true-up or correction.
findings.remediation: Either amend the contract with a true-up order or reduce the provisioned entitlement to the purchased limit.

findings.message: An analytics or data feed is enabled without a matching contract line.
findings.remediation: Disable the unpurchased feed or attach a signed amendment before renewal or usage reporting.

recommendedActions: Attach entitlement findings to the revenue operations review packet.
Reconcile contract lines against provisioned seats, quotas, feeds, and support tier.
Regenerate delivery evidence after provisioning or commercial amendments are complete.

results.title: Expired data license still marked revenue-ready

findings.message: The delivery date is missing or outside the active contract term.
findings.remediation: Align delivery with the active contract term or execute a renewal/amendment before revenue workflows proceed.

findings.message: Revenue recognition remains ready while entitlement-delivery findings are unresolved.
findings.remediation: Set a revenue hold until delivery evidence, quota parity, support tier, and term checks pass.

recommendedActions: Place revenue recognition and renewal automation on hold.
Attach entitlement findings to the revenue operations review packet.
Reconcile contract lines against provisioned seats, quotas, feeds, and support tier.
Regenerate delivery evidence after provisioning or commercial amendments are complete.
